put.summary: Reorder gallery photos. Body must list every shop photo ID in the new display order (first = cover).

post.summary: Attach already-uploaded gallery photos (presign via Media, then send storage keys here).

delete.summary: Remove gallery photos by id. Remaining photos are reindexed.

put.summary: Replace the full set of filter tags assigned to a shop.

delete.summary: Soft-deactivates a tag (IsActive = false). Slug remains reserved.

get.summary: Returns coffee shop and review counts for the admin dashboard.

post.summary: Create a new check-in at a coffee shop
post.description:
**Process:**
1. Takes shop ID and optional message from body.
2. Automatically injects User ID and Name from Gateway headers.
3. Registers the visit in the system.

400.description: Invalid shop ID or business logic violation

get.summary: Get paginated list of check-ins for the current user
get.description:
**Note on Pagination:**
This endpoint uses **Custom Headers** for pagination control instead of query parameters.

**Response Headers:**
- `X-Total-Count`: Total number of check-ins
- `X-Total-Pages`: Total number of pages
- `X-Current-Page`: Current page index

get.summary: Search for coffee shops with advanced filters
get.description:
This endpoint allows you to search for coffee shops using various filters like city, equipment, beans, and more.
Results are paginated and include metadata in X-Headers.

200.description: Returns list of coffee shops. Check X-Total-Count header for pagination metadata.

get.summary: Get detailed information about a specific coffee shop
get.description:
This endpoint returns full coffee shop details including:
- Average rating and review count
- Top 10 recent reviews
- Personal user interaction status (IsVisited) if authenticated

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier (GUID) of the coffee shop

get.summary: Get coffee shops within geographical boundaries
get.description:
Use this endpoint to fetch coffee shops for map-based views. 
It requires a bounding box defined by minimum and maximum coordinates.

**Constraints:**
- Latitude: -90 to 90
- Longitude: -180 to 180
- Min values must be lower than Max values.

200.description: Returns a list of shops found within the specified area

400.description: Invalid coordinates or bounding box geometry
